profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: Enjoy developing software that shapes the overall users experience on the web. I specialize in both front-end and full stack projects.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Collaborated with the engineering team to develop logistics and AI chat software for inventory management.  
• Constructed client-side functionality in NextJS, ReactJS, Angular 18 and TypeScript for data management applications.  
• Architected and developed RESTful API logic and secure middleware using Django and Python.  
• Followed TDD/BDD practices to ensure high-quality code and prevent technical debt.
positions.insights: Skills: Next.js · TypeScript · Azure DevOps Server · Figma · Python · Angular

positions.title: Front End Engineer
positions.description:
Created UI and single page structure with state management for human resource faculty 
member data management application.

• Wrote secure API logic for Java Sprint Boot microservices involving user permissions and tokens.
. Developed error handling and api test within .NET 8 environment.
• Managed database migrations within Postgres and written raw SQL queries and 
queries using Hibernate ORM.
• Architect front-end single page applications (React / TypeScript) and mobile application (React Native) while collaborating with server-side engineers / quality 
insurance.
• Use Jenkins for pipeline deployment processes for certain environments.
• Created unit test for microservices using JUnit 5 along with Jest within the front 
end for components to prevent unnecessary discrepancies within the production 
environment.
positions.insights: Skills: React.js · TypeScript · Figma · Jenkins · Tailwind CSS · Agile Methodologies · Node.js · Java · .NET Framework

positions.title: Full Stack Engineer
positions.description:
Built and refactored software for human resources (customer facing and internal) 
 applications and services.

• Developed functionality for various services pertaining to API’s and service workers (file upload management, user permissions and emails) with Nodejs / MongoDB.
• Developed logic to assist with Elastic Search to handle large data sets. 
• Written logic within the client side for both AngularJS and Vue components for 
single page architecture.
• Constructed database by analyzing data and constructing tables for future application features.
• Worked within AWS to manage instances and buckets for deployment purposes.
positions.insights: Skills: Node.js · AngularJS · MongoDB · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · JavaScript · Agile Methodologies

positions.title: Front End Engineer
positions.description:
• Assisted in refactoring legacy architecture to enhance performance and maintainability.  
Work within a JavaScript environment (Ember JS and React / Typescript).
• Developed features for both white label and internal software using a full stack .NET MVC structure.  
• Collaborated with design teams to create user-friendly interfaces using Figma, ensuring a seamless user experience.  
• Managed deployment processes within Jenkins, streamlining release cycles and improving efficiency.
positions.insights: Skills: Linux · Node.js · MongoDB · Git · Ember.js · React.js · TypeScript · Agile Methodologies · C# · Java

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Create functionality for transportation security administration processing application.
• Collaborate with engineers to construct software architecture
(NextJs/TypeScript).
• Wrote and performed extensive unit and end to end test for application (TDD). 
• Provided suggestion to implement UI functionality for the improvement of the 
user experience
positions.insights: Skills: Next.js · TypeScript · Electron.js · React.js · Jenkins · Agile Methodologies · Java · Spring Boot

This process involved communicating with other team members to provide insight on best practices relative to data manipulation on the front end. This also included developing reusable modules that provides a fluid user experience on the front end.

positions.title: Front End Engineer
positions.description:
Developed and assisted in architecture for the latest version of the company’s software to migrate from legacy version. 
• Collaborated with a global team to solve challenges with software. 
• Finalized development of company’s product (C# / Angular / React / Typescript) for production release which has increased user’s experience. 
• Refactor Python API business logic and database models. 
• Mentored other team members with the front-end architecture to ensure code integrity.
positions.insights: Skills: Linux · Node.js · Git · React.js · JavaScript · SASS · es6 · Agile Methodologies · Angular · C# · TypeScript

positions.title: Senior Front End Engineer
positions.description: Worked with digital marketing international and local team to develop and release interactive promotion web sites. I've provided critical input on each project from a software perspective during the planning phase for each project. Development and extensive testing was performed to insure each site met the companies goals.
positions.insights: Skills: Backbone.js · Git · React.js · CSS · JavaScript · Agile & Waterfall Methodologies

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:

•	Include data caching and file loading optimization to expedite application performance.
•	Developed in house software within an MVC structure using Zend Frameworks 2.
•	Used Propel ORM and migration workflow to manage databases.
•	Created PERL scripts for particular server task such as email.
•	Maintained code through Git for version control.
positions.insights: Skills: PHP · MySQL · Zend · Python · Perl · Backbone.js

•	Wrote queries to handle data with a MySQL database.
